subject: *: add ctx parameter to infoschema TableByID (#55329)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent focusing on executor/planner/session/statistics/table behavior and the InfoSchema API change. The change is primarily mechanical plumbing: `InfoSchema.TableByID` now accepts a `context.Context`, most call sites pass `context.Background()` and a few propagate an existing request/statement ctx; `infoschemaV2` forwards ctx into `loadTableInfo` for tracing region attribution. No remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantics/consistency/concurrency/privilege issues identified within the scoped areas.
